item.text:
**Findings**
- Medium: the debugging settings layer still had the same log-level wiring repeated across package preference classes and per-package debugging fragments. The duplication was split across two layers, which made even a small behavior change awkward to keep consistent.

I refactored that into a shared contract and two reusable settings abstractions. `termux-shared` now exposes [TermuxAppLogLevelPreferences.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/settings/preferences/TermuxAppLogLevelPreferences.java:7), and [TermuxPackageAppSharedPreferences.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/settings/preferences/TermuxPackageAppSharedPreferences.java:14) owns the common log-level implementation behind `getLogLevelPreferenceKey()`. That let the package-specific preference classes drop their repeated `getLogLevel(...)` / `setLogLevel(...)` bodies and just provide the key, for example in [TermuxAppSharedPreferences.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/settings/preferences/TermuxAppSharedPreferences.java:99).

On the app side, I added [BasePackageDebuggingPreferencesFragment.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/fragments/settings/BasePackageDebuggingPreferencesFragment.java:12) and [BasePackageDebuggingPreferenceDataStore.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/fragments/settings/BasePackageDebuggingPreferenceDataStore.java:11). The simple plugin debugging fragments now just declare resource + preference builder, e.g. [termux_api/DebuggingPreferencesFragment.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/fragments/settings/termux_api/DebuggingPreferencesFragment.java:13). The Termux and Termux:Float variants keep only their package-specific boolean handling, with the main-app in-memory log-level behavior preserved explicitly in [termux/DebuggingPreferencesFragment.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/fragments/settings/termux/DebuggingPreferencesFragment.java:16).

Static verification only: repo-wide search shows the old per-fragment log-level boilerplate is gone from the debugging settings area, and the remaining `build(context, true)` settings hits are in unrelated terminal IO/view preference stores.
